test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the statements about the reaction below is/are correct?

2ZnO (s) + C(s) → 2 Zn (s) + CO₂ (g)

(i) Zinc is getting reduced

(ii) Carbon is getting oxidised

(iii) Zinc is getting oxidized.

(iv) Carbon is getting reduced
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (i) and (ii).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• A chemical reaction known as an **oxidation-reduction (redox) reaction **includes the exchange of **electrons **between **two **substances.
 
• In a **redox reaction**, an **electron **is either **gained **or **lost**, **changing **the **oxidation number **of a molecule, an atom, or an ion.
 
• The given equation is redox reaction.
 
 
• **2ZnO (s) + C(s) → 2 Zn (s) + CO2 (g)**
 
 
 
• Here in this reaction **Zn **is **reduced **because it has gained electrons.
 
• While **Carbon **is **oxidized **because it has lost electrons. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The oxidation states of the reactants change during **redox reactions**, which are** oxidation-reduction **chemical processes.
 
• Reduction-oxidation is referred to as **redox**.
 
• All redox reactions can be divided into **two **parts:
 
 
• **reduction reactions.**
 
• **oxidation reactions.**
 
 
 
• Oxidation and reduction reactions **occur simultaneously **during all redox or oxidation-reduction processes.
 
• The substance that is being **reduced **in a chemical reaction is referred to as the **reducing agent,** and the substance that is being **oxidised **is referred to as the** oxidising agent. **
